sources.title: GitHub - ziplab/History-Forcing: Official code for History Forcing ...
sources.snippet: History Forcing is a unified on-policy distillation framework for few-step autoregressive video generators. It compares teacher predictions with and without informative history, then adds the weighted residual to the score or velocity target used for distillation.

sources.title: [2611.02782] History Forcing: Distilling History-Dependent ...
sources.snippet: To address this gap, we introduce \textbf {History Forcing}, a unified on-policy distillation framework that strengthens historical supervision for few-step autoregressive video generators. The framework uses the residual between teacher predictions with and without informative historical context to decouple this supervision.
